name: Snowsky Salt Industry Group CO.,LTD
summary: Snowsky Salt Industry Group CO.,LTD engages in the research, development, production, and sale of salt and salt chemical products in China. It offers edible packaged salts, such as well, lake, and sea salts, as well as basic iodized refined salts, non-iodized refined salts, pickling salts, eco-friendly edible salts, seaweed iodized salts, seaweed iodized low-sodium salts, rock crystal salts, and freshwater salts.
